scenarios.desc: Copilot CLI exit code 2 and timeout semantics for hooks
scenarios.input: I am about to change a cross-harness hook. What does exit code 2 do in GitHub Copilot CLI, and what happens when a PreToolUse hook times out? Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: SKILL.md 'GitHub Copilot CLI Contract': exit 2 warns and continues by default and denies only for PreToolUse and PermissionRequest; timeouts fail open on every event. A generic Claude-hook answer would say exit 2 always blocks.

scenarios.desc: Decision payload shape differs between Claude Code and Copilot CLI
scenarios.input: What is the hook payload format for a PreToolUse permission decision on Claude Code versus Copilot CLI? Which envelope field do I emit on each harness? Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: SKILL.md contract table and Copilot section: Claude uses nested hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision, Copilot uses a top-level permissionDecision, never the nested envelope and never a top-level decision.
